full_name: Alexander Rehding | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Humanities Rieman and Baketel Fellow for Music Harvard University
bio: Alexander Rehding is the Fanny Peabody Professor of Music at Harvard University, an affiliate of the Department of Germanic Languages and Literatures, and an associate at the Center for European Studies. His work lies at the crossroads of music history and theory.
